about: Back-test cases for Layer B (docs/forward_plan_policy_costing.md §6.3, F-B-05): the PC National simulations whose shock is a productivity change in named industries. Industries are PC National industry numbers (pc_national.initial_gsp.pcn_no). Shock sizes and industries are taken from each simulation's scenario text in the PC workbook (pc_national.simulations.scenario and .sectors). Type: lp = labour productivity (labour-augmenting); mfp = capital and labour productivity, or primary factor productivity (Hicks-neutral, value added); kp = capital productivity (capital-augmenting).
